about_the_game:
Experience a gripping action roguelike where you face endless waves of enemies! In Sweet Slaughter, choose a hero with unique abilities and battle against ever-increasing hordes of monsters. With each level-up, you can choose from Modifiers and Augments to enhance your stats and gain additional special effects.

After 15 minutes, a powerful boss appears, which you must defeat to successfully complete your adventure.

Key Features:

  • Diverse Heroes: Choose from various characters, each with unique abilities and playstyles.

  • Strategic Choices: After selecting your Attribute Augments, you can unlock powerful Effect Augments that grant unique advantages in battle.

  • Survival Mode: Can you survive for 15 minutes against the hordes of monsters?

  • Dynamic Events: Engage in events that appear on the map, offering valuable rewards

    Prepare for a challenging experience that tests your skills and strategic decisions as you fight against cute but deadly monsters!
